title: DEFINE step 3 PR 8: applyOverrideToFreezeRecord writer
description: src/define/freeze-record.js grows `applyOverrideToFreezeRecord({ projectRoot, reason, by, at })` which loads or creates a freeze record (stamped `frozenAt=now`, `treeHash=currentTreeHash` of the live tree, `docHashes` empty when no prior freeze), sets `override: { reason, by, at }` and writes through saveFreezeRecord. Reuses the existing SHA256 schema and canonical-JSON contract so the output is identical in shape to a freeze-verb write.
